## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are generic and contain no credentials, private artifacts, or organization-specific rules.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and English help/error text are updated.
- [ ] Behavior changes include regression tests and preserve backup/recovery safeguards.
- [ ] Limitations and compatibility changes are documented.
